text:
Alex Kim: Hey @runtime @infra @security — can we get eyes on PR 17654? https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/17654 It touches the autoscaler config and the eviction header (adds tenant id). Need runtime + infra + security approvals before tomorrow's merge window.

Priya Desai: Quick Q — which exact files are changed and did CI run the long e2e suite?

Alex Kim: Files changed:
```
services/runtime/autoscaler/config.py
runtime/eviction/header.proto
infra/deploy/helm/values.yaml
```
CI: all unit/integration checks green, e2e flaky on one test (timing), link: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/17654
Perf bench on a small cluster shows ~1-3% throughput variance, nothing alarming.

Samir Patel: I can take the runtime review. Main concern: adding tenant id to eviction header might surface PII if not hashed/filtered. Also check KV cache key derivation. Will review and reply by ~16:00 PT.

Emily Chen: I will run the security checklist — header changes + Helm values for KMS usage. ETA tomorrow EOD unless I find something blocking.

InfraBot: CI status: build/17654 — all checks passed ✅ (unit, integration, linters)

Alex Kim: Thanks. @Samir @Emily @Priya note that the canary policy is enabled in the PR:
```yaml
canary:
  percent: 10
  duration: 30m
  fallback: scale-to-default
```
Plan is to merge in the 10:00am PST window tomorrow if no blockers.

Samir Patel: LGTM for runtime, left one tiny nit about metric name (autoscaler.upscale_count -> autoscaler.scale_up_count). No perf regressions observed in my local run. :+1:

Emily Chen: Security review complete — tenant id in header is pseudonymized before emit, Helm change points to existing KMS key ARN, no new IAM perms. Marking security approved. :shield:

Priya Desai: Release coordination: approved for merge window. Please add a one-line migration note in the PR description.

Alex Kim: Great — merging tomorrow 10:00am PST. Thanks for the quick turns, everyone :tada:
